data.long_meaning: Paridhi is a Sanskrit name derived from the root 'paridh' meaning 'to bestow'. It signifies a gift, something that is bestowed upon an individual or a situation. In Hindu mythology, Paridhi is the name of a celestial nymph, a giver of blessings and boons. The name Paridhi carries the meaning “Gifted, Bestowed” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Paridhi usually hope their child will grow to embody gifted, bestowed and live with faith, good character and purpose.
